scripts.build:server: esbuild server/src/main.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node24 --outfile=build/server.mjs --external:@napi-rs/canvas --external:bufferutil --external:utf-8-validate --banner:js="import { createRequire as __cr } from 'node:module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);" --log-level=warning
scripts.build:ios: vite build --mode ios && cap sync ios

scripts.android: npm run build:android && cap open android
